detail: backend/tests/test_approval_chain_reroute.py landed: 20 scenario tests (AC-21 x2, AC-22, AC-20 x3, lifecycle parity x4, authority parity x1, workflow M2 guard x2, fast-lane parity x1, intake-strip parity x4, no-rungs-companion x1) + 1 parametrized AST bounded-diff test (x3 files). Found and fixed a real deadlock in this test file's own fixture (not a product bug): a pre-begun external Connection transaction made every service-layer db.commit() a no-op against the real transaction, so the audit hash-chain's global pg_advisory_xact_lock (app/core/audit.py) stayed held for the whole test once any write_audit_log call fired; app.core.authz.record_decision's isolated SessionLocal() (used to log a 403 denial so it survives rollback) then blocked forever trying to acquire the same lock. Fixed by not pre-beginning the Connection transaction in this file's db fixture (letting Session commits be real, like production), confirmed via an isolated repro script before and after the fix. ruff clean; pytest tests/test_approval_chain_reroute.py -q: 21 passed in 6.89s; full suite pytest -q: 472 passed, 6 skipped (451 baseline + 21 new, zero regressions).
